_comment: Every listing ever seen. Dead ones stay here with a terminal status so they never resurface as 'new'. posted_days_ago is relative to 'last_refreshed' below - re-run a search rather than hand-adjusting it.
source_note: Pulled from Indeed on 2026-09-03 across 6 searches: EEG technologist trainee (Hollywood), neurodiagnostic technologist (Miami), EEG technician (Fort Lauderdale), EEG (Miami), behavioral health technician (Hollywood), psychiatric technician (Miami), clinical research coordinator neurology (Fort Lauderdale). The two purely neurodiagnostic searches returned zero results - South Florida is thin on EEG trainee postings right now. SECOND PASS via ZipRecruiter, same searches: 34 EEG matches and 12 neurodiagnostic matches within 40-45 miles, including a Cleveland Clinic EEG Technician Apprentice in Weston and an EEG Technician at Joe DiMaggio Children's Hospital in Hollywood. Indeed returned zero for the identical queries. Never conclude the market is empty from one board.

listings.title: Neurology Technician
listings.description: The Neurologic Wellness Institute in Boca Raton, FL is looking for a Full-Time Neurology Technician to join our team. Our ideal candidate is a self-starter, professional, punctual, and reliable. Benefits: We offer many great benefits, including PTO and Quarterly Bonus. Responsibilities: Reports to Lead Clinician and Clinical Director. Perform daily opening and closing procedures including cleaning and turning on equipment and lights. Perform patient diagnostics. Document intake history and examination for lead clinician. Upload diagnostics to EHR system. Assist in patient therapies and documentation in EHR. Clean and put away all exam and treatment equipment. Ensure that the treatment and restroom areas remain calm, welcoming, and clean. Uphold the positive reputation of our office by always treating visitors in a friendly, welcoming, and compassionate manner. Abide by all office policies and procedures. Preferred Skills/Abilities: Strong people/communication and development skills. Electronic Health Records knowledge. Experience in a Medical Clinic or Therapy Clinic. Education and Experience: Associate's degree or job-related vocational training. Benefits: Paid time off. Work Location: In person.
listings.notes: Closest thing to a neuro-diagnostic role currently posted in her range. 'Perform patient diagnostics' at a neurology practice is the door. Education bar is an associate's degree - she has a BS in Neuroscience, so she is over it. No pay published; ask on the call. Boca Raton is roughly a 40-minute drive from Hollywood.

listings.title: PSG / Sleep Tech
listings.description: PSG sleep tech polysomnography position at Hispano Medical Center in Miami FL. Contract.
listings.notes: Polysomnography is the sister discipline to EEG - same electrode montages, same ABRET-adjacent credential track (RPSGT). If they train, this is a genuine Tier 1 entry point at $25/hr. Description not yet pulled; get the full posting before applying.

listings.title: Mental Health Tech, Jackson Behavioral Health, State Civil Beds Unit, Full-Time, Nights
listings.description: Mental Health Tech position at Jackson Behavioral Health, State Civil Beds Unit, full-time nights. Jackson Health System, Miami FL. Psychiatric inpatient behavioral health setting.
listings.notes: This is the building where she did her Miami Summer Scholars psychiatry rotation in 2018 - neuropsych assessments, therapeutic interviewing, shadowing psychiatrists in outpatient clinics. She can say that in the first line of her cover letter. Salary floor is about $21.80/hr with a full hospital benefits package. Night shift is the standard way in.

listings.title: Experienced Mental Health Tech, Jackson Behavioral Hospital, Per Diem, Variable Shifts
listings.description: Experienced Mental Health Tech at Jackson Behavioral Hospital. Per diem, variable shifts. Requires prior experience.
listings.notes: Same hospital as the full-time posting but explicitly asks for experience, and it is 140 days old. The full-time nights req is the better door.

listings.title: Mental Health Technician
listings.company: Douglas Gardens Community Mental Health Center
listings.description: Mental Health Technician at Douglas Gardens Community Mental Health Center, North Miami Beach FL. Full-time community mental health setting.
listings.notes: Posted yesterday, so the application actually gets read. Community mental health center - broad psychiatric exposure. Pay starts low at $15/hr; worth asking what the range tops out at.

listings.title: OVERNIGHT Behavioral Health Technician
listings.description: Overnight Behavioral Health Technician at Compassion Behavioral Health, Fort Lauderdale FL. Full-time overnight shift.
listings.notes: Overnight BHT roles are the most reliably open door in South Florida behavioral health, and they rarely require a credential up front. 25 minutes from Hollywood.

listings.title: Registered Behavior Technician
listings.description: Registered Behavior Technician position at Limitless Kids ABA, Fort Lauderdale FL. Part-time. ABA therapy with children.
listings.notes: Highest hourly rate on the board. RBT work is directly continuous with her ESE support tutoring and the 70 shadowing hours with ADHD, ODD, and autism students. Most ABA companies pay for the 40-hour RBT certification - confirm that before applying, because that is what turns this from a job into a credential.

listings.title: Registered Behavior Technician (RBT)
listings.description: Registered Behavior Technician RBT at House of Hearts Florida, Oakland Park FL. Part-time.
listings.notes: Top of range is $33/hr. Same RBT-certification question applies.

listings.title: Registered Behavior Technician RBT - Part Time
listings.description: Registered Behavior Technician RBT part-time at Butterfly Effects LLC, Boca Raton FL.
listings.notes: Posted yesterday. Butterfly Effects is a large established ABA provider and usually runs its own RBT training pipeline.

listings.title: RBT/BT
listings.description: RBT/BT position at Little Rays ABA, Aventura FL. Full-time. BT means behavior technician - typically open to uncertified applicants.
listings.notes: Listed as RBT/BT, and 'BT' usually signals they will take an uncertified applicant and train them. Aventura is where she worked at Whole Foods, so she knows the commute.

listings.title: Behavior Assistant with Team PBS in Florida
listings.description: Behavior Assistant with Team PBS in Florida, Dania FL. Part-time.
listings.notes: Dania is the closest listing on the board to Hollywood - about 10 minutes. 'Behavior Assistant' rather than RBT suggests no certification required up front.

listings.title: Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) Roles at Team PBS in Florida
listings.description: Registered Behavior Technician RBT roles at Team PBS in Florida, Deerfield Beach FL. Part-time.
listings.notes: Same employer as the Dania posting but further out and much older. Apply to Dania instead.

listings.title: Behavior Technician
listings.description: Behavior Technician at Little Leaves Behavioral Services, Miami Lakes FL.
listings.notes: 111 days old and no schedule listed. Low priority.

listings.title: Direct Support Professional
listings.description: Direct Support Professional starting at $18.00 per hour at Health & Behavioral Dimensions Inc, Hallandale Beach FL. Full-time.
listings.notes: Hallandale Beach is about 10 minutes from Hollywood. DSP roles almost always train from scratch. Genuine direct-care hours, though it advances the psychiatry path less than a hospital behavioral health role would.

listings.title: Clinical Research Assistant / Medical Assistant
listings.description: Clinical Research Assistant / Medical Assistant at CenExel Clinical Research, Hollywood FL. Full-time clinical research site role supporting trials.
listings.notes: In her own city. CenExel's Hollywood site runs psychiatry and CNS trials, which lines up exactly with the Sobell TLFB literature review and the Munoz neurogenesis lab work. About $18/hr at the floor. 91 days old, but CRO reqs stay posted - worth one application.

listings.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
listings.description: Clinical Research Coordinator at Segal Institute for Clinical Research, Lauderhill FL. Full-time.
listings.notes: Segal runs a large psychiatry and CNS trial portfolio in Broward. Roughly $22/hr floor. Her paid Sobell RA position and RStudio work are directly on point.

listings.title: Regulatory Coordinator
listings.description: Regulatory Coordinator at CenExel Clinical Research, Hollywood FL. Full-time. IRB submissions, regulatory documentation, trial compliance.
listings.notes: In Hollywood, pays better than the research assistant req, and IRB/regulatory documentation is close to what she did on the Sobell systematic review. No patient contact though, so it advances the psychiatry path less.

listings.title: Research Associate 1
listings.description: Research Associate 1 at University of Miami, Miami FL. Full-time laboratory and clinical research support.
listings.notes: University of Miami is where she did the Miami Summer Scholars program. University benefits usually include tuition remission, which matters if a master's is still on the table. Her PCR, ELISA, and cell culture skills fit a wet-lab associate role.

listings.title: Quality Assurance Coordinator (Clinical Research)
listings.description: Quality Assurance Coordinator for clinical research at CenExel Clinical Research, Hollywood FL. Full-time.
listings.notes: Third CenExel Hollywood req. Administrative rather than clinical - treat as a backup.

listings.title: Clinical Research Principal Investigator (Neurologist)
listings.description: Clinical Research Principal Investigator position requiring a licensed Neurologist. MD required. Gemini Medical Research, Hialeah FL.
listings.notes: Requires an MD and a neurology board certification. Kept on file only as a marker that Gemini Medical Research runs neurology trials in Hialeah - worth checking their site for coordinator-level openings.

listings.title: Client Care Coordinator (BHT)
listings.description: Client Care Coordinator BHT at The Luminous Care, Margate FL.
listings.notes: Posted December 2024. Long dead. Marked closed so it never resurfaces.

listings.title: EEG Technician Apprentice
listings.description: EEG Technician Apprentice, Cleveland Clinic, Weston FL. Full-time on-site apprenticeship position in neurodiagnostics.
listings.notes: This is the job the entire board was built to find: a named apprenticeship, at a top-tier system, 25 minutes from Hollywood, paying $52.5k at the floor. Apply first and apply today. Lead with the BS in Neuroscience, the Munoz neurogenesis lab, and advanced Haitian Creole.

listings.title: EEG Technician - FT - Days - JDCH
listings.description: EEG Technician, full-time days, at Joe DiMaggio Children's Hospital (JDCH), Memorial Healthcare System, Hollywood FL. On-site pediatric neurodiagnostics.
listings.notes: JDCH is Joe DiMaggio Children's Hospital, in her own city. Memorial serves a large Haitian Creole-speaking population, so her advanced Creole is a genuine hiring edge here, not a footnote. Pediatric EEG also connects to her ESE work with ADHD and autistic children.

listings.title: Neurophysiology Tech Assistant, Neurophysiology Office, FT
listings.description: Neurophysiology Tech Assistant in the Neurophysiology Office at Baptist Health South Florida, Miami FL. Full-time, 8:00am to 4:30pm, on-site.
listings.notes: Lowest pay on the neuro list at about $15.38/hr, and deliberately not filtered out for it. 'Assistant' in a neurophysiology department is the classic side door into EEG at a system that promotes internally. Weekday daytime hours, which is rare in this field.

listings.title: Pool EEG Technician, Neurophysiology, Per Diem
listings.description: Pool EEG Technician, Neurophysiology department, per diem, 6A to 6:30P shifts. Baptist Health South Florida, Boca Raton FL.
listings.notes: Per diem pool roles usually want someone already trained, but Baptist runs a large neurophysiology service and pool staff often convert to full-time. Worth an application even if the answer is 'not yet'.

listings.title: Registered Neurodiagnostic Technologist - FT - Flex - $10K Sign on Bonus - JDCH
listings.description: Registered Neurodiagnostic Technologist, full-time flex, $10,000 sign-on bonus, at Joe DiMaggio Children's Hospital, Memorial Healthcare, Hollywood FL. Requires registered technologist credential. Benefits: Medical, Vision, Dental, Paid time off, Retirement.
listings.notes: Requires the ABRET registration she does not have yet, so the board correctly penalises it. Keep it visible anyway: it is the same department as the EEG Technician req above, in her own city, with a $10K sign-on. This is what the apprenticeship path leads to in about two years.

listings.title: Neurodiagnostic Tech II - EEG Tech
listings.description: Neurodiagnostic Tech II, EEG Tech, at UNC Health, Miami FL. Full-time on-site. Tech II is a mid-level grade requiring prior neurodiagnostic experience.
listings.notes: 'Tech II' means they want someone already trained. Logged for the salary benchmark and as a target for later, not a now application.

listings.title: EEG Technician
listings.description: EEG Technician position in Fort Lauderdale FL through Field of Talent, a recruiting and staffing firm. Full-time on-site.
listings.notes: Field of Talent is a staffing firm, so the board discounts it, but recruiters will sometimes place an untrained candidate a hospital would screen out. Low cost to send a resume.

listings.title: Per Diem EEG Technologist
listings.description: Per Diem EEG Technologist at Specialy Care, Fort Lauderdale FL. On-site per diem work.
listings.notes: Highest rate on the board but per diem technologist work assumes you can already run a study unsupervised. Benchmark, not a now application.

listings.title: EEG Technologist Traveling
listings.description: Traveling EEG Technologist role covering a travel assignment, through Field of Talent staffing, based Miami FL.
listings.notes: Travel assignment through a staffing firm. Both penalised, correctly. Listed for completeness.
